description: This file contains utility functions for managing products and calculating taxes and totals in an e-commerce backend, including disabling products, calculating tax amounts for orders and items, and formatting orders.

methods.name: disableProducts
methods.description: Disables a list of products by setting their 'isActive' status to false using bulk write.

methods.name: caculateTaxAmount
methods.description: Calculates total tax for an order, updating each product's totalPrice, totalTax, and priceWithTax, and adjusting the order total accordingly.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price of all non-cancelled products in an order.

methods.name: caculateItemsSalesTax
methods.description: Calculates sales tax for a list of items, updating each item's totalPrice, totalTax, and priceWithTax.

methods.name: formatOrders
methods.description: Formats a list of orders, extracting relevant fields and recalculating tax amounts for each order.
